note: PILOT-A2 tempo map (LIB-8R, DESIGN.md section 4; research claude/libht-research @ 0d832e18). Timed rows (D-LIB8M-TEMPO): a row s is the card's plate.tempo[from]; up is the concentric phase, down the eccentric; pause 0 on both, so no Hold. Untimed rows (D-STRIP-ROWS): the card and spec tempo is exactly tempoOf(strip/rows.json) for the id. No constants, no Rest.
